title: Gold harness stack mh-dev-01
description: Using only normal user-space and GitHub-controlled execution, install/complete DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and stagewise where headless operation is supported. Add illegal-xd/delx-memory-bun as the local-first MCP persistent-memory component for DSH/Astra, using its documented Bun runtime and loopback HTTP/stdio mode. Do not use sudo, do not modify canonical Astra transport, and do not change production services. Validate versions/help, build/install status, delx-memory doctor/health, DSH local startup readiness, and connectivity to the existing Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Treat illegal-xd/WebTool-DeepSeek as client-side Chrome extension only: document it as optional UI integration, do not install a browser extension on the server. Then execute bounded Astra coding qualification and publish evidence to control/results/mh-dev-01.json via GitHub.
